description: Type ASCII text into the focused field. Waits for the soft keyboard first, so it is safe to call right after tapping a field. Options: clear the field first, press ENTER after. Non-ASCII characters are not supported by adb input.

clear.description: Clear the field before typing (select-all + delete)

serial.description: Device serial (defaults to session or the only device)
